policy_source: README 'Dispute policy' (AD-13) and app/policy.py at commit 1b5e6de (screening + per-reason evidence checks), README scenario table for conversational rules (AD-8 human request, out of scope, charge list).

fields.extraction: what the FIRST message states (currency null unless the customer names it; 'pesos'/'$' alone is not a currency); a list of dates accepts either; a missing key is not scored
fields.expected_reason: the dispute reason the explanation assessment should return; null when the case never reaches the explanation step
fields.acceptable_charges: charges the customer would confirm as theirs (either charge of a claimed duplicate pair)
fields.expected_credit_transactions: credited charge(s) that count as correct; empty when no credit is allowed

S03-es.rationale: AD-13 duplicate v1: an Approved twin at the same merchant, exact amount and type, at most 1 day apart (TAXI-1/TAXI-2) -> one charge of the pair reversed (shared credit key, so either id is the same reversal).

S04-es.rationale: The customer's own account says they may have taken a taxi both days: the explanation contradicts a double charge (inconsistent) or stays unclear after one follow-up -> person (evaluate_explanation). Most judgment-dependent label in the set.
S04-es.adjudication: Codex labeled the reason 'unclear', Claude 'duplicate'. Adjudicated: both accepted. The customer claims a double charge (duplicate) but is unsure it was one ride, which the policy's 'unclear' also covers; the expected outcome (escalated, needs_review, no credit) is the same under either reading.
